about_the_game:
Alaric's Quest is a charming 2D platformer with a hand-drawn medieval setting that will take you on an exciting adventure. This game is designed for Linux, Windows, and SteamDeck, meaning you can enjoy the action on a wide variety of devices. Additionally, Alaric's Quest supports different types of controls, including keyboard, gamepad, and touchscreen, allowing you to choose the option that best suits your playstyle.

In Alaric's Quest, you'll dive into a magical and colorful world. Taking control of Alaric, the brave protagonist, your mission is to overcome challenging platforming levels, solve puzzles, and defeat enemies to recover your stolen book collection from evil minions.

Key Features:

• Exciting Platforming Experience – Alaric's Quest offers classic platforming gameplay with precise jumps, challenging obstacles, and clever traps. You'll need to master jumping mechanics and carefully explore each level to progress through the story.

• Variety of Levels and Challenges – The game features a wide range of levels, each with its own set of challenges and puzzles to solve. Face ferocious enemies, dodge deadly traps, and uncover hidden secrets as you explore the kingdom.

• Multi-Platform and Controller Support – Alaric's Quest is available for Linux, Windows, and SteamDeck, ensuring you can enjoy the adventure on your favorite devices. The game is also compatible with keyboard, gamepad, and touchscreen controls, offering flexibility in how you play.

• Accessible Yet Challenging Gameplay – The game features easy-to-learn controls, making it accessible to players of all ages and skill levels. However, as you progress, levels become increasingly difficult, testing even the most experienced players. Get ready to face clever traps and formidable enemies as you advance in your quest.

Alaric's Quest promises fun no matter the platform or control method you prefer. Get ready to embark on this thrilling medieval adventure!
